text:
jamal: Quick sync — planning a cross-zone deploy for embeddings-svc Thursday 2026-03-19 09:30 PT. Expected window ~20m, canary 10m -> full. Need smoke owner, rollback ready, and any blocking PRs. @ellie @taylor

ellie: I'm +1 to own rollback and can watch metrics during canary. What's the model size?

jamal: model v2.1 quantized, ~7B. Binary at s3://releases/embeddings/v2.1.tar.gz. Rolling deploy via k8s: canary 10%, then 50% then 100%.

priya: Heads-up — there's one open CR from @kevin on model serialization. It's small but unmerged. CI flagged flaky test in embed-tests. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/1234

taylor: I can run smoke checks and do perf cursory. Need the smoke checklist.

jamal: dropping smoke checklist below. Run in staging then prod canary:

```
# smoke checklist
1) curl -s -X POST https://canary.redwood/embeddings -d '{"text":"hello"}' | jq .
2) check response latency < 120ms p50
3) tail logs: kubectl logs -l app=embeddings -n prod --since=5m | grep "kv-cache"
4) assert embedding dim == 1536
```

Also rollback command:
`./deploy rollback embeddings v2.0 --force`

devops: deploy job scheduled -> https://ci.internal/jobs/9876. ETA 09:30 PT. all containers built: ✅. Canary route ready in us-west1 and eu-central. :rocket:

release-bot: Canary allocation policy set to [10%,50%,100%] with 5m watch windows. Auto-fallback to v2.0 on error >=5% over 5m.

ellie: will monitor SLO dashboards, ping if success <95%. @taylor, pls confirm you can be on call 09:30-10:00 PT.

taylor: Confirmed. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results here. :thumbsup:

priya: I'll chase the CR — if it doesn't land by EOD, we should consider shipping behind a feature flag.

jamal: Good. If anyone sees regressions during canary, run rollback command and post reason. Otherwise we'll proceed with full rollout at ~09:50 PT.

taylor: Smoke run in staging now — all good. latency p50 85ms, embedding dim 1536. Logs normal. Artifacts: https://artifacts/embeddings/smoke/3898765432

jamal: Thanks. Channel note: owners for this deploy: jamal (lead), ellie (rollback/watch), taylor (smoke), priya (CR).

release-bot: Deploy complete: canary -> full at 09:49 PT. No automatic rollback triggered.

jamal: Closing thread. Great job team. :tada:
